question: The Constituent Assembly adopted the constitution of India on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**26th November 1949**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution of India on **26th November 1949**.
 
• This date is celebrated as **Constitution Day** or **Samvidhan Divas** in India.
 
• The Constitution came into effect on **26th January 1950**, marking the day when India became a republic.
 
• The adoption of the Constitution marked the culmination of the Indian independence movement and laid down the framework for the governance of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written constitution** of any country in the world.
 
• It establishes the fundamental political principles, structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic**, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The Constitution has undergone several amendments to address the evolving needs and challenges of the nation.
